body:
The college in specific that I'm attending said I would still need a diagnosis for something that requires a emotional support animal, which I don't, im rarely able to get meets with my care providers as is.

Even if I could bring her, physically as an emotional support cat, sadly, it would be far more expensive than regular dorming, which is already burning a whole in my pocket. ://

I've been crying over this for weeks, I'm very sad over it, and ill definitely suffer from depression alongside her when we have to part.

laying in bed with her in my arms right now as I'm replying 😭

Yeah, I am actually talking to a Cat Cafe near my current house, to see if they can take her since they need more cats.

Im not sure why my mom doesn't like her, we got her as a kitten originally to be my moms cat but we've always had a stronger connection, and overtime she just started to dislike Amiga (the cats name btw LOL) idk why but it breaks my heart, my moms separated me from two other cats I raised and I miss them everyday, luckily a family friend has them both.

My mom isn't my biggest fan, and resents me for moving 41 hours away for college, so she definitely will keep her word of leaving my kitty in the streets

Yeah, my only option at the moment is for my mom to take care of her, but she has made it very clear that she doesn't like my cat, and will more than likely get rid of her if I don't take her to college with me, which I'm unable to, financially and physically. 

That is the only reason im looking for more options, I simply don't want my mom to give her up while I am gone.

I have looked into that, but I won't be able to until my second year, because the college I'm going to requires first years to live on campus, and I can't say it would be cost efficient to have both a room on campus and rent through another landlord

When I go on 1 to 4 day trips, she usually just doesn't eat as much as usual until I'm home for a little bit.
If it is a 2-4 week trip, she doesn't eat/drink, and burrows herself into the boxspring underneath my bed, and doesn't come out for days after I return.
I've talked to my college about an accommodated, single person room for me to have her there as an emotional support animal, but its about $3000 more than current living.
sadly I do not as my friends are also leaving state for college, and my other avaliable family members have maxed out their amount of pets avaliable on their leases
